 Chitwan Rhinos Defeat Janakpur Bolts by 4 Wickets in NPL
 Ratopati
 November 13, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. In the second match of the third edition of Nepal Premier League (NPL) on Friday, Chitwan Rhinos reached close to the playoffs by defeating Janakpur Bolts by 4 wickets. Chitwan, chasing a target of 89 runs set by Janakpur, completed the target by losing 6 wickets in 17 overs.
 Chitwan's David Malan remained unbeaten on 35 off 39 balls with 1 six. Similarly, Kushal Malla scored 15 off 25 balls with 1 four, Ravi Bopara scored 13 off 16 balls with 3 fours, and Kamil Mishra scored 12 off 6 balls with 1 six and 1 four.
 Janakpur's Rahul Yadav took 3 wickets, captain Harmeet Singh took 2 wickets, and Vishal Sushling took 1 wicket.
